Title: FIPS 199 Security Categorization
Description: Categorize the information system's security impact level (Low, Moderate, or High) for confidentiality, integrity, and availability per FIPS 199, based on the types of federal data the system will process, store, or transmit.

Title: Baseline Selection
Description: Select the FedRAMP-tailored NIST SP 800-53 control baseline (Low, Moderate, or High) corresponding to the system's FIPS 199 categorization. FedRAMP baselines add FedRAMP-specific parameters and supplemental controls beyond the base NIST baselines.

Title: FedRAMP Tailored / LI-SaaS Eligibility
Description: Determine eligibility for the FedRAMP Tailored Low-Impact Software-as-a-Service (LI-SaaS) baseline, a reduced control set for low-risk, low-sensitivity SaaS offerings that do not store PII beyond basic login credentials.

Title: JAB Provisional Authorization (P-ATO)
Description: Pursue a Provisional Authorization to Operate issued by the Joint Authorization Board (JAB — DoD, DHS, GSA), typically reserved for CSPs with broad, high-demand, government-wide use cases. JAB P-ATOs are limited in number annually and require Continuous Monitoring coordination with the JAB.

Title: Agency Authorization (Agency ATO)
Description: Pursue an Authority to Operate issued directly by a sponsoring federal agency after that agency reviews the security package. This is the most common authorization path for most cloud service offerings (CSOs).

Title: FedRAMP Tailored Authorization
Description: Pursue authorization under the FedRAMP Tailored baseline for low-risk SaaS solutions meeting LI-SaaS criteria, using a streamlined security package and reduced assessment scope.

Title: Agency/JAB Sponsorship Requirement
Description: Secure sponsorship from a federal agency (Agency path) or committed agency partners (JAB path) before initiating the authorization process. FedRAMP does not authorize a CSO without a sponsoring or authorizing agency in place.

Title: FedRAMP Ready Entry Point
Description: Enter the FedRAMP process via a 'FedRAMP Ready' designation (a readiness assessment performed by a 3PAO) prior to full 'In Process' status, signaling market readiness to potential agency sponsors and the JAB.

Title: System Security Plan (SSP)
Description: Develop and maintain a System Security Plan describing the authorization boundary, control implementation detail, system environment, interconnections, and responsible parties, using the current FedRAMP SSP template.

Title: Security Assessment Plan (SAP)
Description: Develop a Security Assessment Plan, prepared by the 3PAO, describing the assessment scope, methodology, sampling approach, and rules of engagement for the independent security assessment.

Title: Security Assessment Report (SAR)
Description: Obtain a Security Assessment Report from the 3PAO documenting assessment findings, control effectiveness determinations, and identified vulnerabilities/weaknesses, with risk ratings.

Title: Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M)
Description: Maintain a POA&M documenting identified weaknesses, risk ratings, remediation milestones, resources required, and scheduled completion dates. The POA&M is a living document updated on a required monthly cadence.

Title: Contingency Plan (CP) & IT Contingency Plan
Description: Develop a Contingency Plan, including an IT Contingency Plan for information system recovery, addressing continuity of operations following a disruption, and test it at least annually.

Title: Incident Response Plan (IRP)
Description: Develop and maintain an Incident Response Plan aligned to NIST SP 800-61 and FedRAMP incident reporting requirements, including US-CERT/CISA reporting timelines and agency/JAB notification procedures.

Title: Configuration Management Plan (CMP)
Description: Develop a Configuration Management Plan documenting baseline configurations, change control processes, and configuration monitoring across the authorization boundary.

Title: Rules of Behavior (RoB)
Description: Develop Rules of Behavior describing acceptable use expectations for all users with access to the system; require signed acknowledgment prior to granting access.

Title: Control Implementation Summary / Customer Responsibility Matrix
Description: Document a Control Implementation Summary and Customer Responsibility Matrix clarifying which controls are inherited, shared, or the responsibility of the customer (leveraging) agency.

Title: Continuous Monitoring Plan
Description: Develop a Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) Plan describing the ongoing monitoring strategy, vulnerability scanning cadence, and reporting obligations that apply after authorization.

Title: Independent Assessment Requirement
Description: Engage a FedRAMP-accredited Third Party Assessment Organization (3PAO) to perform the initial security assessment. Self-assessment is not an accepted path under FedRAMP, unlike the self-attestation options available in some other compliance frameworks.

Title: 3PAO Accreditation Verification
Description: Confirm the selected 3PAO holds current accreditation from the FedRAMP Program Management Office (PMO) and the American Association for Laboratory Accreditation (A2LA).

Title: Independent Annual Assessment
Description: Engage a 3PAO (or other qualified independent assessor) to perform the required annual security control assessment as part of continuous monitoring, distinct from the initial full assessment.

Title: Monthly Vulnerability Scanning
Description: Perform monthly operating system/infrastructure, database, and web application vulnerability scans across the full authorization boundary and submit scan results/summaries to the authorizing official on the required cadence.

Title: Monthly POA&M Updates
Description: Update the POA&M monthly with the current status of open items, newly identified vulnerabilities, and remediation progress evidence; submit to the AO/JAB per the ConMon deliverable schedule.

Title: Annual Security Assessment
Description: Undergo an annual security assessment (full or AO-approved targeted scope) to verify continued control effectiveness across the authorization boundary.

Title: Annual Penetration Test
Description: Undergo an annual penetration test performed by a qualified assessor covering the authorization boundary, with results incorporated into the POA&M.

Title: Annual Contingency Plan Test
Description: Conduct an annual test/exercise of the Contingency Plan and document results, deficiencies, and lessons learned.

Title: ConMon Deliverable Submission
Description: Submit all required continuous monitoring deliverables (scan results, POA&M updates, incident reports, significant change requests, annual assessment and test results) to the authorizing agency or JAB per the agreed ConMon schedule.

Title: Significant Change Request (SCR) Process
Description: Notify and obtain approval from the authorizing official (agency AO or JAB) before implementing significant changes to the authorized system (e.g., new interconnections, major architecture changes, cloud region changes) via a documented Significant Change Request.

Title: Change Impact Analysis
Description: Perform and document a security impact analysis for proposed changes to determine whether a change qualifies as 'significant' and requires prior AO notification/approval, versus routine change management handled internally.

Title: US-CERT/CISA Incident Reporting Timeline
Description: Report confirmed security incidents affecting federal data to US-CERT/CISA within the timeframe mandated by federal incident reporting requirements, as referenced in the FedRAMP Incident Communications Procedure.

Title: Incident Reporting to Authorizing Officials
Description: Notify the authorizing agency's AO and, where applicable, the JAB, of security incidents per the timelines and contact procedures documented in the Incident Response Plan.

Title: Marketplace Status Tracking
Description: Track and maintain the CSO's designation on the FedRAMP Marketplace (e.g., FedRAMP Ready, In Process, Authorized) as the authorization progresses.

Title: FedRAMP Ready Designation
Description: Obtain a 'FedRAMP Ready' designation via a 3PAO-conducted Readiness Assessment Report (RAR) prior to entering full 'In Process' status, demonstrating baseline readiness to prospective agency sponsors.

Title: Sustained Authorized Status
Description: Maintain 'Authorized' status on the Marketplace through sustained ConMon compliance; authorization can be suspended or revoked for ConMon deliverable non-compliance or unresolved high-risk findings.

Title: Authorization Boundary Diagram
Description: Maintain a complete and accurate authorization boundary diagram identifying all components, interconnections, and external services within the system's FedRAMP authorization boundary.

Title: Data Flow Diagram
Description: Maintain data flow diagrams depicting how federal data moves into, through, and out of the system, including the encryption status at each flow point.

Title: Leveraged Authorizations & Interconnections
Description: Document any underlying infrastructure or platform services (leveraged authorizations) the CSO relies on, including their own FedRAMP authorization status, and any external system interconnections requiring an Interconnection Security Agreement (ISA).

Title: Personnel Screening for Federal Data Access
Description: Screen personnel (background investigation appropriate to position risk designation) prior to granting access to systems processing federal data, per agency-specific requirements and the personnel security control family.

Title: Foreign National / Access Restrictions
Description: Apply agency-specific restrictions on foreign national access to federal data and systems, where required by the sponsoring agency's policies.
